description: DEP-03 §The dispute and DEP-06 Phase 4 step 2, from real regtest ledgers: which DisputeEnters, arms and manifests belong to the current dispute, the recovery voters (the members of Q, the operator's latest QuorumBegin at or below the highest last_valid_sequence any DisputeEnter names, less the operator), each round's arms in a window, and the landed lottery. `updates` are the signed updates (TLV, hex) of the base chain and of every fork a member held (each fork's own updates only). `expect.in_dispute`/`out_of_dispute` are the disputants (33-byte keys) whose latest DisputeEnter is or is not at or above Q; an out-of-dispute fork's arms are no arms of any round (and a member holding only such a fork MUST NOT arm a later round). `recovery_voters` are before the accused exclusion (x-only, sorted); `accused` is given (it needs the grounds judged) and `lottery` is the lottery over manifest 0's arms with `recovery_voters` less `accused`: its spk is the confirmed output's. `round1_arms` is each in-dispute armer's latest of its first four arms that is of round 1 and signed at or below the confiscation height; `windows` give each in-dispute armer's arm for the round in (opens, closes] (pick-round-arms over the in-dispute arms); `manifests` are judged as DEP-03 §Arm manifests over the in-dispute arms. Shared by cl-deposits (inspect/lottery-test.lisp), deposits-rust (deposits-node armers.rs) and the spec (vectors/).

cases.name: 8082521c: a yielded stale DisputeEnter (lvs 4, below Q 8) and its round-2 re-arms take no part
cases.note: regtest-devnet 2026-11-20/21. cld364 (023d42a6) was a member of QuorumBegin 4 only; it entered at last_valid_sequence 4 (expiry), yielded at seq 6 when QuorumBegin 8 re-established the quorum, and from block 34846 armed round 2 six times (seqs 7-12) on that fork. The confiscation's lottery (output 0 of a3c673df, block 34554) is over QuorumBegin 8's voters. ref6 (deposits-rust 718fbbf) derived voters [cld364, ref6] from QuorumBegin 4, so its lottery (spk 5120eccb...) never matched and it logged 'no unspent output pays our participant set yet' every minute.

cases.name: 12bc96d2: the same stale DisputeEnter made a Rust voter refuse the winners' subset attestations
cases.note: regtest-devnet 2026-11-19/21. cld364 entered at 4 and yielded; QuorumBegin 8 replaced it with cld558 (02698eed). The lottery (output 0 of d2aa3db5, block 23996) is over QuorumBegin 8's voters; ref6 refused every lottery_subset_attest for it 'no pending lottery on chain' (38 times, 20:41-21:20Z Nov 19), its lottery being over QuorumBegin 4's. c30c1b29's round-2 arm (seq 11, height 24141) is in the dispute and counts; cld364's round-2 arms (seqs 7-16, from 34799) do not.

cases.name: 34651658: a sole participant's lottery, unclaimable by it because its voters came from the stale QuorumBegin
cases.note: regtest-devnet 2026-11-19/21. The lottery (output 0 of 85159943, block 31255) has ref6 as its sole participant and ref6 as its sole voter (QuorumBegin 8 less the two accused), so ref6 could claim it with its own signature at once; it derived voters [cld364, ref6] from QuorumBegin 4 (spk 5120dda6...) and never found it. The same wrong spk is what ref6 derived for 0f8ead80 and f6b7ab1a, whose lotteries pay this case's spk 70806ecd.... cld364 armed round 2 seventeen times (seqs 7-23).

cases.name: a01fc163: the control: no stale DisputeEnter, both implementations derive the landed lottery
cases.note: regtest-devnet 2026-11-20/21. Participants ref6 and cld704 (022e382b), voters the same two (QuorumBegin 12 less the accused cld705), threshold 2. Both implementations agree. ref6 revealed and requests subset attestations every minute; ref7 refuses them 'not a recovery voter' (correctly: removed before QuorumBegin 12) and the only other voter, cld704, has been down since 14:21:01Z Nov 20, a minute after it signed the confiscation. A liveness strand, not a derivation one.
